provenance.note: Mod notecard. Instructions for the table, not a published rule.

faces.transcription:
Scripting works by pulling a new Legacy Deck out of the infinite bag. The deck on the table is for you to use and save. Any auto-generated Legacy Cards by the setup should be manually deleted when you complete the month (win or lose).

Always check both sides of a Legacy Card.

Delete this card after it has been read.
